name: voice_control
description: Control the voice conversation session. action=exit: end the current voice conversation and let the device return to wake-word standby. Call this when the user semantically asks to leave/dismiss you or says goodbye (in any language), e.g. asking you to stand down, saying they are done for now, or bidding farewell. Do NOT call it when leaving/exiting is part of another request (e.g. asking how to log out of an account). The farewell you pass in 'ack' is spoken aloud to the user; your following text reply is NOT spoken, so keep it minimal. action=volume: read or change the device speaker volume while talking. Call this when the user asks to turn the volume up/down, set a specific level, or says your voice is too loud/quiet (input comes from speech recognition, so interpret homophone typos charitably). Pass level (0-100) for an absolute target, or adjust for a relative step (use 10 / -10 when the user just says louder/quieter without a number); omit both to only report the current volume. The change is persisted and takes effect immediately, including for your spoken confirmation, so answer with one short spoken-style sentence stating the new volume.

action.description: exit = end the voice conversation; volume = get/set the device speaker volume

ack.description: For action=exit only: a very short farewell spoken aloud to the user, in the user's language with a warm natural tone, one short sentence, e.g. 'Sure, talk to you later' or 'Okay, I'll be here if you need me'.

level.description: For action=volume only: absolute speaker volume, 0-100

adjust.description: For action=volume only: relative change, e.g. 10 (louder) or -10 (quieter)
